findings.title: Instagram's 2026 Reels guide names 15-60s as the main sweet spot
findings.insight: Instagram's creator guide (reported Sep 28) sets three length tiers: 3-15s for quick moments, 15-60s as the primary sweet spot, and 60s-3min for storytelling and education. LittleLoop can make 15-60s episodes its core format, test occasional longer story or learning episodes, and use auto-captions plus the Edits app's keyframes for animation polish.

evidence.title: Instagram Shares Ultimate Blueprint for Viral Reels in 2026

findings.title: Pressure is rising on AI-generated kids' video and AI labelling
findings.insight: About 200 groups led by Fairplay asked YouTube (Apr 2026) to label all AI content and stop recommending it to minors; YouTube said it is building AI labels for YouTube Kids. In Sep 2026 Instagram changed how it labels AI profiles amid pushback. LittleLoop should disclose AI use plainly, keep human review on every episode, and favour original recurring characters over template output.

findings.title: YouTube is adding A/B tests for up to three video cuts
findings.insight: Announced at Made on YouTube (Sep 23, 2026): creators will be able to upload two or three cuts of a video and compare retention curves, alongside dynamic thumbnails served by audience segment. Marked 'coming soon' with no date. Sunverse can prepare alternate opening hooks for music videos and Shorts so it is ready to test when the feature reaches the channel.

findings.title: YouTube clarified that generic, template-based AI content can't be monetized
findings.insight: From Jul 16, 2026, YPP defines 'inauthentic content' including generic, repetitive or template-based videos easy to mass-produce with AI or templates; channels with too much of it lose monetization. Loop-style music uploads with near-identical visuals are exposed. Sunverse should keep releases distinct per track (original visuals, credits, production context).

findings.title: Gemini chat editing for Shorts can sync music to the beat
findings.insight: Made on YouTube 2026 showed conversational editing in Shorts and YouTube Create: draft a cut from a prompt, then refine by chat, including reordering, trimming and syncing music to the beat, with manual timeline fallback. Availability not specified. Sunverse could use it to cut beat-synced Shorts teasers from each release once available.

findings.title: Squarespace raised annual prices by up to 26% in July 2026
findings.insight: Two reports say Squarespace's annual Core and Plus plans rose 26% and Basic 19% (Advanced unchanged), effective July 6 and applying to existing users at renewal, with no feature changes reported. Price-sensitive creatives may be comparing options; Foliocraft can make its free vs premium value clear and transparent.

findings.title: Framer added a cheaper content-only editor seat and more Basic bandwidth
findings.insight: Framer (June 2026) raised Basic plan bandwidth 5x and added a $10/month Content Editor seat for CMS and on-page edits without design permissions, below its $20 Editor role. Role-based, lower-cost collaborator access is a possible Foliocraft premium feature, e.g. letting a client or mentor edit text only.
